summary: John's 5th-great-grand-aunt; her 1842 death was misattached to her mother in the tree.
bio:
Keturah (1791-1842) married Samuel Ackley. Her 1842 death is the date the tree wrongly gives her mother (Harvey Book p.360).

FamilySearch gives Keturah the dates 18 Feb 1791 to 9 Dec 1842 and her marriage to Samuel Ackley on 18 Jun 1815. Its attached 1830 census entry is indexed under 'Caturah Akley' as head of household ([R4-S1]).
